# Smarter.Poker

> Smarter.Poker is a free online poker platform: GTO training, private poker clubs in Poker Arena, Club Commander room management, live venue discovery, home games and a bankroll manager. Free to play, no real-money gambling.

## What this is, and what it is not

Smarter.Poker is operated by Smarter Software Inc. There is no real-money
gambling on the platform. Club chips are play credits with no cash value and
diamonds are a promotional rewards currency. Nothing on the platform pays out
cash, and no wager placed here is a real-money wager. The platform is free to
play and intended for players aged 18 and over.

The trading name "Smarter Poker" is shared with unrelated businesses. The
entity described in this file is the one at https://smarter.poker, and
https://smarter.poker/about is the page that states it.

## Core Features

### GTO Training Engine
Interactive poker training with 100+ scenario-based games covering MTT, Cash, Spins & SNGs, Mental Game, and Advanced Theory. Powered by AI coaching from Jarvis, the tactical intelligence layer. Free to play.
- Training hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/training
- Poker glossary, 49 terms defined: https://smarter.poker/hub/training/glossary

### Poker Near Me
Live poker room and venue finder with real-time game information, tournament
schedules, and interactive maps covering venues across the United States. This
is the largest body of content on the site: several hundred venue profiles,
tournament series and tour pages, each rendered on the server with its own
schedule, location and structured data.
- Lobby: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/lobby
- Rooms by state and city: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/in
- Venue directory: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/venues
- Poker tours and circuits: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-tours
- Tournament series: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/series
- Home games by state and city: https://smarter.poker/hub/home-games
- Example venue profile: https://smarter.poker/hub/venues/1832
- Example tour: https://smarter.poker/hub/tours/WSOP

### Bankroll Manager
Bankroll tracking for poker players. Log sessions, analyse leaks, monitor ROI, and visualise trends with detailed analytics and variance analysis. Free to use, and it tracks play credits, not real money.
- Bankroll manager: https://smarter.poker/hub/bankroll-manager

### Poker Trivia
Test and expand poker knowledge across several game modes: Endless, Survival,
Time Attack and Mixed, each on the same question bank, with leaderboards,
achievements and streak tracking.
- Trivia hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia
- Survival, one life: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia/survival-game
- Leaderboard: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia/leaderboard

### Diamond Store
Premium poker merchandise and gear marketplace with cart, wishlist, and order management.

### Poker Arena (Club Arena)
Private online poker clubs with real-time cash games (Hold'em, Omaha, Short Deck, Pineapple), multi-table tournaments, hand histories and replays, player statistics, leaderboards, unions between clubs, a club cashier and chip ledger, agent tools and full club management. Diamond Arena games run inside the same arena using the platform's Diamond currency.
- Landing page: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena
- Help Center: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/help
- Fair Gaming standards: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/legal/fair-gaming
- Terms, privacy and promotion rules: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/legal

### Club Commander
Live poker room management for venues and their players: remote waitlists with call notifications, live game boards, tournament registration and clocks, home games, season leagues, dealer rotation, cashier, player rewards and comps, and responsible gaming tools.
- Player hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander
- Live poker rooms and venues: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/venues
- Tournaments: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/tournaments
- Home games: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/home-games
- Leagues: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/leagues
- FAQ: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/faq
- Responsible gaming: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/responsible-gaming

### Social Hub
Full social platform with friends, messaging, social pages, reels, news feed, leaderboards, and community engagement features.

### Poker News
Aggregated poker news from multiple sources, updated hourly.

### Video Library
Curated poker video content library with watch history tracking and AI tactical analysis.

### Memory Games
Poker-themed cognitive training games to improve memory and pattern recognition.


### Events Calendar
Poker tournament and event calendar with live updates.

## AI Features

- **Jarvis**: Elite tactical GTO intelligence layer providing solver-grade analysis
- **Geeves**: Robot butler-style live help assistant for user support
- **Proactive Help**: Context-aware assistance suggestions throughout the platform

## The company

- Legal entity: Smarter Software Inc.
- Site: https://smarter.poker
- Support: support@smarter.poker
- Open work: https://github.com/Smarter-Poker

## Technical Details

- **URL**: https://smarter.poker
- **Platform**: Web application (progressive web app)
- **Framework**: Next.js (World Hub), React + Vite (Club Arena)
- **Pricing**: Free to play, with an optional VIP subscription. No real-money gambling, and no cash payouts.
